csv_project_name: Engineering for Papio NRD Chalco Entrance Road
csv_agency: Papio Missouri River Natural Resources District
csv_scope_of_work: The Papio-Missouri River Natural Resources District (Papio NRD) is requesting proposals for professional engineering services necessary to design, permit and provide construction administration for the construction of a new Chalco Recreation Area entrance road (see attached maps). This project will include final design for approximately 1,200 lf of entrance road to relocate the current entrance of Chalco to the intersection of 156th and Giles and associated intersection, utility and trail relocation; procurement of necessary state and federal permits; production of construction documents including cost estimates; and construction contract administration services. A traffic study and conceptual design has been completed by Felsburg, Holt & Ullevig. Coordination with Sarpy County will be necessary.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Traffic Design Engineering, Traffic Studies
